Title: Await async.each with async function as parameter
Description: I can't await async.each with async function as parameter.
Is there a way to achieve this?

**What version of async are you using?**

3.1.0

**Which environment did the issue occur in (Node version/browser version)**

Node v10.16.0

**What did you do? Please include a minimal reproducable case illustrating issue.**

```
console.log('Hello');

await async.each(array, async(item) => {
    await asyncFunction1(item);
    await asyncFunction2(item);
});

console.log('Hello 2')
```


**What did you expect to happen?**

```
Hello
Hello2
```

**What was the actual result?**

```
Hello
```
